rationale: Third-party bodily injury (neighbor's child) arising from condition of the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), which is a classic premises liability scenario.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping and falling on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a high-severity premises liability claim requiring immediate investigation and legal review of potential third-party obligations.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway
case_facts.claim_basis: medical bills for treatment of broken wrist
